name: Percent Frame Window
description: Frame window counter (240 TPS) for percent-macro position macros: how many ticks earlier/later each click and release can be and still pass.

scan-radius.name: Scan radius (ticks)
scan-radius.description: Maximum ticks tested on each side of the recorded input.

max-width.name: Stop at width (10+)
max-width.description: As soon as a click window is this many ticks wide it is labelled 10+ and the next click is analysed. 0 = measure every window fully.

thorough-scan.name: Thorough scan
thorough-scan.description: Test EVERY offset in the radius instead of stopping at the first fail on each side. Slower, but finds separate passing islands.

probe-beyond.name: Probe beyond first fail
probe-beyond.description: Extra offsets tested past the first fail on each side to detect islands (ignored in thorough mode).

verify-boundaries.name: Verify boundaries
verify-boundaries.description: Run each boundary offset twice. A disagreement shrinks the window and marks it UNSTABLE.

only-action.name: Only action #
only-action.description: Analyse only the input containing this action number (1 = first data line). 0 = analyse everything.

skip-free-releases.name: Skip free releases
skip-free-releases.description: A release that survives -N and +N ticks (N below) is not analysed: it has no real window (for example a release after a jump over spikes). Only a test at exactly -N and +N, so a release that fails somewhere in between could be missed.

use-checkpoints.name: Use practice checkpoints
use-checkpoints.description: In practice mode, start every trial from a checkpoint taken at the previous input of the ORIGINAL macro instead of the level start (much faster). Falls back to the level start by itself if the checkpoint run does not reproduce the original timing. NOTE: analysing clears the practice checkpoints you placed yourself.

horizon-groups.name: Survive until N following inputs
horizon-groups.description: PASS = survive until this many following inputs of the ORIGINAL macro fired. 1 = a click must survive until its release, a release until the next click.

horizon-min-ticks.name: Survive at least (ticks)
horizon-min-ticks.description: ...and at least this many ticks after the tested input (0 = off).

horizon-margin.name: Extra ticks after that input
horizon-margin.description: Also survive this many ticks after the following input fired.

horizon-to-end.name: Survive to end of run
horizon-to-end.description: Strictest: survive until the end of the reference run.

speed.name: Speed (x real time)
speed.description: How many times faster than real time the analysis runs, independent of the frame rate (30 = 30x). 0 = MAX: as many ticks as fit in the frame budget below.

frame-budget-ms.name: Max-speed frame budget (ms)
frame-budget-ms.description: Used when Speed is 0: milliseconds of analysis per real frame. Higher = faster analysis but a choppier screen.

fast-mode.name: Fast mode (beta)
fast-mode.description: Hides the level while analysing, runs the physics in big chunks and decides forgiving clicks (10+) with two trials. Experimental: if results look wrong, turn it off.

expected-tps.name: Expected TPS
expected-tps.description: Physics ticks per second the results are labelled with. A warning is shown if the game actually runs differently.

x-epsilon.name: X tolerance
x-epsilon.description: Playback fires an input when player x >= action x - this value.

ignore-early-death-ticks.name: Ignore deaths in first N ticks
ignore-early-death-ticks.description: Workaround if the untouched macro 'dies' right at the start (spawn glitch). 0 = off. The report says what killed the player.

macros-dir.name: Macros folder
macros-dir.description: Leave empty to use the percent-macro mod's folder: .../save/geode/mods/yourname.percentmacro/macros

save-report.name: Save report files
save-report.description: Write <macro>.windows.txt and .csv to this mod's save folder under results/.

settings-button.name: Settings button
settings-button.description: Adds a FW Settings button to the pause menu.

overlay-hud.name: Counter
overlay-hud.description: Show the 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5+ counter in the top-left corner while windows are shown.

overlay-sound.name: Click sound
overlay-sound.description: Play a sound when the player reaches a click: normal pitch for windows of 5+, 0.1 lower per frame down to 1.
